set.body:
Second-population slice A (sub-shape b): close construction on embed-bench Gold.

Gold is a public case class; Gold.validated(units, view) is a real smart constructor
that can return Left; fromProduct can still mint Gold(Map) with a DistortedWithoutAnchor
unit (facets, no primary) that validated refuses.

Fix: final non-case class, bare private constructor, structural equals/hashCode,
intentional toString. Demonstrate fromProduct forge first (outside storymodel4s.bench),
then close the door. Probe package storymodel4s.benchprobe. Same-shape positive control:
GoldUnit.fromProduct still typechecks. Clean recompile for compile-time probes.

Obligation: post the landed probe shape so slices B–D can copy it.
set.title: sweep 2 slice A (embed-bench): close fromProduct on Gold
